name: Upload Any MIME Types – Support SVG, JSON, APK, TTF, and others
author: Prince

sections.description:
Upload Any MIME Types is a powerful plugin that allows uploading commonly restricted formats like SVG, EXE, and many others.

WordPress by default limits the types of files that can be uploaded for security reasons, but this plugin gives you full control to expand those limits safely and efficiently.

Whether you’re a developer, designer, or site administrator, this plugin provides a flexible solution for uploading modern file formats without hassle.

No need to write code or manually edit functions.php — just install, activate, and you’re ready to go.

🔥 Features

📁 Upload Any File Format – Easily upload any file type by selecting or defining allowed MIME types.
🖼️ Native Support for Modern Formats – Seamless handling of SVG, EXE, ICO, JSON, HTML, and more.
🚫 Bypass WordPress Restrictions – Safely override default MIME limitations without modifying core files.
🧰 No Coding Required – User-friendly interface built for simplicity – perfect for beginners and pros alike.
🔐 Secure Upload Validation – Built-in safety checks to block malicious or unsupported files.
💾 Auto Save – Changes to MIME type settings are automatically saved in real-time, eliminating the need for manual saves. Toggle file formats on/off and watch your preferences update instantly – no manual “Save” button is required.
➕ Add Custom MIME Types – Flexibly include your own MIME types with just a few clicks.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
What file types can I upload to WordPress by default?

By default, WordPress only allows cetain types of files to be uploaded to a website for security reasons.

Can I Upload SVG to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading SVG files. Using Upload Any MIME Types plugin, you can now upload and use SVG files in WordPress.

Can I Upload HEIC to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading HEIC image files. This plugin unlocks compatibility so you can upload and display stunning HEIC photos with ease.

Will This Plugin Allow Custom Font Files Upload?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading some font files like TTF, OTF, WOFF, EOT, and others. This plugin opens the gate to easy custom font upload.

Can I Upload APK Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading APK files. This plugin removes that barrier, letting you share Android app packages directly from your site.

Can I Upload Figma Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading Figma (.fig) files. With this plugin, you can upload design files just like images or documents.

Can I Upload GPX Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading GPX files. This plugin enables GPS file uploads so you can share maps, routes, and location data instantly.

Can I Upload EPUB Files to WordPress?

WordPress by default doesn’t allow uploading EPUB files. This plugin makes it simple to upload eBooks and digital publications in just a few clicks.

Help! I need support or have an issue.

Support is available for File Upload Types via the WordPress.org support forums.
